_note: Player names (q(313) ①), read by server/src/p0/accounts/name.ts. 李白's list (11-12; 不知火舞's probe and fixes the same night), on 周瑜's format. Write words plainly and lower-case: the matcher folds case, accents, Cyrillic / Greek look-alikes and 0 1 3 4 5 @ $ itself, lets each letter repeat (fuuuck) and drops spaces and - _ . ' — so write `fuck`, not its spellings. severe: rejected anywhere in the name, inside another word too — only for strings no ordinary name contains. words: rejected when the whole name or one of its words is it (`Big Ass`, not `Cassandra`) — for words that hide inside real names (Thai Porn-, Nazira, Hancock, Essex, Dickens are fine). impersonation: staff-looking names, matched as words. impersonation_anywhere: brand and staff words rejected anywhere. allow: real words that contain a severe one, taken out first. Chinese / Japanese / Korean entries are met anywhere whatever list they sit in; traditional and simplified are separate entries. The player only ever sees `That name isn't allowed`. A new word needs a server deploy, not a client release. Plurals: a whole word also takes an English plural's s / es (周瑜 11-12, at 不知火舞's ask), so the 40 plural entries once written out were taken out (one of them, asses, refused Assess).
